findings.question: indicator C1: Does the state operate its own government data centres that are in operation today?
findings.quote: veikta Iekšlietu ministrijas IKT un datu centru infrastruktūras atjaunošana un paplašināšana, kā arī attīstīti infrastruktūras līmeņa pakalpojumi valsts datu apstrādes mākoņa ietvarā

findings.question: indicator C2: Is a national sovereign or government cloud platform in operation (not announced)?

review.reason: The live VDAA service page describes a platform that gives centralised access to, and helps institutions choose, state cloud services (a catalogue and brokerage under MK Nr. 606), not a government cloud that VDAA itself runs; the page also mentions commercial providers.

findings.question: Border and visa systems: National parts of SIS, VIS and Entry/Exit, visa and border-crossing records
findings.quote: Iekšlietu digitālais centrs (IDC) īsteno projektu, kura ietvaros tiek attīstīta Valsts robežsardzes elektronisko informācijas sistēma (REIS) un ieviesta Ieceļošanas/izceļošanas sistēmas (IIS) nacionālā daļa
findings.quote_english: The Interior Digital Centre (IDC) is carrying out a project to develop the State Border Guard electronic information system (REIS) and to implement the national part of the Entry/Exit System (IIS)
findings.value: Iekšlietu digitālais centrs (IDC) (Interior Digital Centre)
findings.title: Iekšlietu digitālais centrs turpina īstenot projektu Nr. IC/RPVP/2024/9
findings.publisher: Iekšlietu ministrijas Informācijas centrs / Iekšlietu digitālais centrs
findings.note: IDC appears to be the new name of the Interior Ministry Information Centre. The page shows it building the system, and does not state that it is the statutory controller.

review.established: Iekšlietu digitālais centrs (IDC) (implementing the REIS/IIS development project)
review.reason: The quote shows the IDC carrying out the project that develops REIS and the national EES part; strictly, that makes IDC the developer, not a stated operator.

findings.question: Border and visa systems: National parts of SIS, VIS and Entry/Exit, visa and border-crossing records
findings.quote: Nacionālās vīzu informācijas sistēmas (NVIS) lietošana un attīstīšana
findings.quote_english: Use and development of the National Visa Information System (NVIS)
findings.value: Nacionālā vīzu informācijas sistēma (NVIS) (National Visa Information System)
findings.title: Nacionālās vīzu informācijas sistēmas (NVIS) lietošana un attīstīšana
findings.note: The national visa system is the national counterpart of VIS. PMLP runs the project with the Interior Ministry Information Centre, the Border Guard and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

review.reason: The quote is a PMLP project title naming the National Visa Information System; it does not state who operates it.

findings.question: Firearms register: Licensed firearms and their holders
findings.quote: Vienotas šaujamieroču, to sastāvdaļu, lielas enerģijas pneimatisko ieroču, gāzes ieroču un signālieroču, salūtieroču, dezaktivēto ieroču, šaujamieroču un salūtieroču munīcijas un personām izsniegto ieroču atļauju uzskaites nodrošināšana.
findings.quote_english: Ensuring unified records of firearms, their components, high-energy air guns, gas and signal weapons, salute weapons, deactivated weapons, firearm and salute ammunition, and weapon permits issued to persons.
findings.value: Ieroču reģistrs (Weapons Register)
findings.title: Ieroču reģistrs
findings.note: The register name is the page heading. The quote gives the register's purpose, including records of permits issued to persons.

review.reason: The quote gives the purpose of the register (unified records of weapons and permits) but does not contain its name or its operator.

findings.question: Firearms register: Licensed firearms and their holders
findings.quote: Ieroču reģistra turētājs un pārzinis ir Iekšlietu ministrijas Informācijas centrs.
findings.quote_english: The holder and controller of the Weapons Register is the Information Centre of the Ministry of the Interior.
findings.value: Iekšlietu ministrijas Informācijas centrs (Information Centre of the Ministry of the Interior)
findings.title: Ieroču aprites likums
findings.note: From the consolidated Weapons Circulation Law, whose amendments run to 2026.

review.established: Ieroču reģistrs; operator Iekšlietu ministrijas Informācijas centrs
review.reason: The regulation says the Interior Ministry Information Centre is the holder and controller of the Weapons Register.

findings.question: Official gazette and legislation: Authentic text of laws and regulations
findings.quote: Latvijas Republikas oficiālajā izdevumā “Latvijas Vēstnesis” publicē: ārējos normatīvos aktus, arī pašvaldību saistošos noteikumus, kā arī citus tiesību aktus;
findings.quote_english: The official publication of the Republic of Latvia 'Latvijas Vēstnesis' publishes: external regulatory enactments, including municipal binding regulations, and other legal acts;
findings.value: “Latvijas Vēstnesis” (official publication of the Republic of Latvia)
findings.title: Oficiālais izdevums
findings.note: The official publisher's own page. Its electronic edition at vestnesis.lv is legally binding.

review.reason: The quote says laws and other legal acts are published in the official publication Latvijas Vēstnesis; it does not name who operates it.

findings.question: Treasury and state accounts: Budget execution, treasury payments and government accounting
findings.quote: Klientam, kam Valsts kasē ir atvērts konts, ir plašas iespējas veikt dažāda veida maksājumus Valsts kases nodrošinātajās maksājumu valūtās, izmantojot ePakalpojumu Maksājumi
findings.quote_english: A client with an account at the Treasury can make many kinds of payments in the currencies the Treasury supports, using the e-service Payments
findings.value: ePakalpojums Maksājumi (Treasury Payments e-service)
findings.title: Norēķini
findings.note: The payment system for Treasury accounts, which the page also calls eKase. The same site lists ePārskati for institutions' reports.

review.reason: The quote says Treasury account holders make payments through the Treasury's ePakalpojums Maksājumi, which the page labels eKase.

findings.question: Treasury and state accounts: Budget execution, treasury payments and government accounting
findings.quote: Valsts kases funkcijas: Valsts budžeta izpildes un finanšu uzskaites organizēšana; Asignējumu piešķiršana un maksājumu veikšana no valsts budžeta ieņēmumiem;
findings.quote_english: Functions of the Treasury: organising state budget execution and financial accounting; granting appropriations and making payments from state budget revenue;
findings.value: Valsts kase (State Treasury)
findings.title: Par mums
findings.note: The Treasury is a direct administration institution under the Ministry of Finance.

review.reason: The Treasury lists state budget execution, financial accounting and payments from the budget among its functions; the quote names no system.

findings.question: Government payroll and personnel: Civil service and armed forces payroll and personnel records
findings.quote: Centralizētais finanšu grāmatvedības un personāla lietvedības risinājuma projektējums ir pieejams
findings.quote_english: The design of the Centralised Financial Accounting and Personnel Records Solution is available
findings.value: Centralizētais finanšu grāmatvedības un personāla lietvedības risinājums (Centralised Financial Accounting and Personnel Records Solution)
findings.title: Centralizētais finanšu grāmatvedības un personāla lietvedības risinājums
findings.note: This is the Treasury Shared Service Centre's central accounting and personnel system for government bodies. The page does not say whether it covers the armed forces, so the finding is weak.

review.reason: The quote says only that the design of a centralised finance and personnel records solution is available; it names no system in operation and no operator.

findings.question: Election management and results: Candidate lists, polling logistics and results tabulation systems
findings.quote: Vēlēšanu informācijas sistēmas modulis (VEL IS), kas nodrošina vēlēšanu pamatdarbības procesus un funkcionalitāti, tostarp kandidātu sarakstus, vēlēšanu gaitas žurnālus, balsu skaitīšanu un datu publicēšanu.
findings.quote_english: The Election Information System module (VEL IS), which supports the core election processes and functions, including candidate lists, election logs, vote counting and data publication.
findings.value: Vēlēšanu informācijas sistēmas modulis (VEL IS) (Election Information System module), part of the Vēlēšanu platforma (Election Platform)
findings.title: Vēlēšanu platforma
findings.note: This covers candidate lists and results tabulation.

review.reason: The quote names VEL IS, the Election Platform module that handles candidate lists, counting and publishing results.

findings.question: Election management and results: Candidate lists, polling logistics and results tabulation systems
findings.quote: VDAA nodrošina Vēlēšanu platformas darbību. Pirms Saeimas vēlēšanām ir veikta platformas pilnveidošana un nepieciešamās pārbaudes.
findings.quote_english: VDAA ensures the operation of the Election Platform. Before the Saeima elections the platform was improved and the necessary checks were carried out.
findings.value: VDAA (Valsts digitālās attīstības aģentūra, State Digital Development Agency)
findings.title: Vēlēšanu platforma ir gatava 2026. gada Saeimas vēlēšanām
findings.note: The Central Election Commission (CVK) is the election authority, and VDAA runs the platform.

review.reason: The quote says VDAA runs the Election Platform, prepared for the 2026 Saeima elections.

findings.question: Central bank systems: Central bank accounts, national payment infrastructure and reserves records
findings.quote: Uzturam un attīstām EKS sistēmu – klientu maksājumiem un zibmaksājumiem. Esam reālā laika TARGET-Latvija sistēmas operators – starpbanku maksājumiem un monetārās politikas operācijām.
findings.quote_english: We maintain and develop the EKS system for customer payments and instant payments. We are the operator of the real-time TARGET-Latvija system for interbank payments and monetary policy operations.
findings.value: EKS sistēma and TARGET-Latvija (EKS clearing system and TARGET-Latvija), operated by Latvijas Banka
findings.title: Maksājumu sistēmas
findings.note: The central bank's own page on the national payment infrastructure.

review.reason: Latvijas Banka says it maintains the EKS system and operates the real-time TARGET-Latvija system.

findings.question: Emergency calls and public-safety radio: 112/PSAP systems, emergency dispatch and TETRA/public-safety networks
findings.quote: ar jaunās Vienotās operatīvo dienestu informācijas sistēmas palīdzību nodod informāciju par notikumu vienlaicīgi visiem iesaistāmajiem operatīvajiem dienestiem
findings.quote_english: using the new Unified Emergency Services Information System, passes information about the incident simultaneously to all emergency services involved
findings.value: Vienotā operatīvo dienestu informācijas sistēma (Unified Emergency Services Information System)
findings.title: Vienotais ārkārtas palīdzības izsaukumu numurs 112 Latvijā
findings.note: This is the 112 dispatch system. The page is from 2020, so its current status should be checked.

review.reason: The quote names the new Unified Emergency Services Information System used by 112 dispatchers; it does not state the operator.

findings.question: Crisis management and civil protection: National crisis centre systems, alerting and continuity plans
findings.quote: Valsts civilās aizsardzības plāns ir plānošanas dokuments, kas tiek sagatavots, ņemot vērā risku novērtējumu
findings.quote_english: The State Civil Protection Plan is a planning document prepared on the basis of a risk assessment
findings.value: Valsts civilās aizsardzības plāns (State Civil Protection Plan)
findings.title: Valsts civilās aizsardzības plāns
findings.note: This covers the continuity-plan part of the holding only. The VUGD site also runs a cell-broadcast alerting system (šūnu apraides sistēma), but I found no quotable name for it.

review.reason: The quote names the State Civil Protection Plan, a planning document; it names no crisis-management system and no operator.
